More job XP from every Blacksmith activity.
A bigger harvest yield when mining.
Higher quality on forged items (not on refining).

Better odds when converting materials to a higher tier.
More forge actions in each forge session.

Lets you make tier 2 and tier 3 Blacksmith mold recipes. Using a mold needs only its job level.
More job XP from every Jeweler activity.
Higher quality on rings and amulets.
Better odds when socketing a gem.
Better odds when converting gems to a higher tier.
A lower cost to remove a gem.

Lets you make tier 2 and tier 3 Jeweler mold recipes. Using a mold needs only its job level.
Hunt monsters to fill your book.
Select a card, then a slot.
Move with W A S D and aim with the mouse. Left click attacks.
Monsters drop items. Stand by a drop and press {hotkey.pickup} to pick it up.
Ctrl dodges through attacks. Dodging and attacking cost stamina, the green bar.
Right click just before a hit lands to parry it.
Skills sit on keys 1-6 and Q E R F Z. Press {hotkey.toggleSkillTree} to learn new ones with your points.
Outposts buy what you find. Press {hotkey.interact} to sell.
Vendors sell potions and food. Press {hotkey.interact} to buy.
The outpost board offers quests: open it with Quests in the sale window.
Level 10: you can leave the tutorial. The passes out of ring 1 are open.
Level 12: jobs are open. Pick your main job at the job master in the city ({hotkey.toggleJobs} shows your jobs).
